title: Top LEGO Sets for Adults: Display-Worthy Builds (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: I selected sets that appear in at least two of the provided sources (CNET, Yours.co.uk, and Wargamer). The picks are ordered by how many sources mention them and by the prominence of the set in each review.
assumptions: Prices are only included when a source explicitly states them; otherwise the price field is null. No external pricing or discount information was added.
